decisions: Independent additional-sedan body, not a compact or police palette transfer.
Source-owned paint per view; roof rectangle excludes rear glass; hidden shoulders are explicit palette fills.
Dark variant and localized palette exceptions require their own source/camera registration before reuse.
Side elevation is independently fitted to source tire centers, roof and hood; north/south retain incompatible front/rear depth estimates.
The single north-owned roof cannot reproduce both opposing paint highlights exactly; front/rear and side glass have separate ownership.
limits: Affine owned UV paint is cleaned authoring, not ray-visible recovery. Own projection/coverage remains separate.
